title: Continental Slope
definition: The continental slope is the steep descent connecting the outer edge of the continental shelf to the deep ocean floor (abyssal plain), marking the true boundary between the continental crust and oceanic crust.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Geography (GS-1) under Oceanography, covering submarine relief features, plate tectonics, sediment dynamics, and international maritime boundaries under UNCLOS.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Continental Slope.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
